panels.title: Power & electricity — measured from Matter wall plugs
System power now (W, wall plugs)
panels.description: Wall power is metered by GRILLPLATS Matter plugs: "Rig" (node 23) and "Minisforum" (node 25), ElectricalPowerMeasurement cluster, meter class ±1%. Rules: rig/config/prometheus-rules/power.yml, group rig_power_plug. Money is reported in EUR with a fixed 117.581053 RSD/EUR (open.er-api.com, 2026-11-06). The old estimate (GPU NVML + CPU RAPL + ~55 W rest, /0.89 PSU) left the dashboard on 06.11 — it under-read by ~2x; its rules stay as rig:power_system_wall_est_watts for pre-06.11 history.

panels.title: Cost now (EUR/h)
panels.description: EPS commercial two-rate tariff incl. network, surcharges, excise 7.5%, VAT 20%: VT 0.2254 / NT 0.1607 EUR/kWh (18.9 / 26.5 RSD, NT 00-08 Belgrade). Fixed monthly fees excluded. docs/20 (sep-2026 invoice).

panels.title: All wall plugs (W)
panels.description: Sum over every device that meters energy (Rig, Minisforum, "Уголь").

panels.title: Wall plugs reporting
panels.description: Metering plugs currently online; a plug that drops out stops its series instead of repeating a stale value (mqtt2prometheus cache.timeout 0).

panels.title: Dashboard range
panels.description: Energy and cost over the time range picked at the top right.

panels.title: Wall plug power vs GPU/CPU draw
panels.description: What the socket draws versus the sum of GPU (NVML) and CPU (RAPL). The gap is monitor, peripherals, disks and PSU losses.

panels.title: Cost, EUR/h
panels.description: Measured wall power x current tariff (NT 00-08 is ~1/3 cheaper).

panels.title: Energy, kWh (integral of measured plug power)
panels.description: The rules publish kW/h (15 s interval); sum of steps x 15/3600 = kWh over the selected window. Not a counter, so increase() does not apply.

panels.title: Wall plugs: W / V / A
panels.description: Per-socket active power, voltage and current (ElectricalPowerMeasurement). Restricted to the metering nodes: the exporter's <Cluster>/<Attribute> topic match also catches other clusters, so an unfiltered selector mixes in unrelated numbers.

panels.title: GPU fan %
panels.description: NVML fan duty per card (3090s: Vix override curve; 5090: VBIOS).

panels.title: Board fans RPM
panels.description: nct6799 headers with a tach: radiator (CPU_FAN1), rear (CPU_FAN2), front 3x140 (CHA_FAN), pump. Bottom 2x P12 Pro on CHA_FAN4 are invisible to Linux (BIOS curve, no tach).

panels.title: Board fan PWM %
panels.description: fancontrol output (all follow CPU Tctl 50-80 C; front floor 110 > rear 75 = positive pressure). Pump = BIOS fixed 255.
